start: Profile tab, no progress photos, 'Include photos in my backup' off

steps.action: Tap 'Body' ('Body weight, measurements and progress photos'), then open Progress photos
user_sees: Page 'Progress photos' with 'Private. They stay on this phone.'
'No photos yet' and 'Take one in the same spot and light every few weeks. Then compare any two side by side.'
must_not: Another member's photos

user_sees: Sheet 'Add a progress photo' with 'Same spot, same light, every few weeks.', 'Take a photo', 'Choose from gallery'
must_not: The camera opening without the choice

steps.action: Tap 'Take a photo' and take it
user_sees: The photo in the list, dated today
must_not: The photo saved into the phone gallery
Two copies of the photo

steps.action: Tap 'Add a photo', 'Choose from gallery', pick a picture with no date of its own
user_sees: 'When was this photo taken?' with 'It came without a date of its own, so it shows today until you pick one.'
must_not: The photo silently dated today

user_sees: The photo sorted under that day
must_not: The date reset on the next open
The compare starting with one photo picked by itself

user_sees: 'Now tap the second photo', then the two side by side
must_not: The same photo on both sides

steps.action: Under 'Add picture' tap 'Take a picture', then 'Save'
user_sees: The measures saved and the picture in Progress photos
must_not: The picture lost when only a picture is added
'Nothing to save' when a picture was added

steps.action: Tap 'Add a photo', then 'Take a photo'
user_sees: 'Camera not allowed. Allow the camera for MettleUp in your phone settings, or choose a photo from the gallery.'
must_not: A crash
A prompt again on every tap
'No photos yet' when photos exist

start: Progress photos page with photos, one of them opened big

steps.action: Tap 'Change date' and pick another day
user_sees: The photo moves to that day
must_not: 'Couldn’t change the date. Please try again.' after a good change
The photo deleted with no question

user_sees: The photo gone from the list; its backup copy gone too
must_not: The file or its backup copy left on the phone
'Couldn’t delete the photo. Please try again.' after it was deleted

The gym or trainer seeing the photos
